tagline: Gentle, modern grooming for dogs and cats in Kannur,Kerala

hero.heading: Where every pet leaves
hero.lead: Gentle, judgment-free grooming for dogs and cats — from a puppy's first bath to a full show-style trim. One-on-one care, no cages, no stress.

why.title: your pet
why.sub: We keep things calm, clean, and honest — for pets and the people who love them.

cards.title: Certified & gentle
cards.text: Every groomer is certified and trained in low-stress handling. Your pet is never rushed, never shared with another client, and never left alone in a cage.

cards.title: Honest, flat pricing
cards.text: No surprise add-ons, no upsell pressure. The price you see on the page is the price you pay — every single time.

cards.title: Clean & eco-friendly
cards.text: We use hypoallergenic, cruelty-free products, sanitized tools between every pet, and a spotless studio you can see for yourself.

services.title: Services built around your pet
services.sub: Every service starts with a 5-minute meet-and-greet so your pet can tell us exactly how they'd like their day to go.

items.title: Full Groom & Styling
items.description: Bath, brush, haircut and finishing touches styled to your pet's breed — and your taste.

items.title: Bath & Brush
items.description: Deep-clean shampoo, conditioner, fluff dry and a tangle-free brush-out for soft, shiny coats.

items.title: De-shedding Treatment
items.description: Specialized undercoat removal that cuts shedding by up to 90% — fewer tumbleweeds at home.

items.title: Nail, Paw & Ear Care
items.description: Gentle trim, file and polish, plus ear cleaning and paw-pad moisturizing. The finishing touch.

items.title: Puppy's First Groom
items.description: A slow, positive introduction to grooming for puppies under 6 months. Treats, praise and patience included.

items.title: Fear-free Cat Grooming
items.description: Low-stress handling, lion cuts and gentle mat removal. Most cats snooze through it. Really.

reviews.title: What pet parents say
reviews.sub: Unedited words from the people who trust us with their best friends.

items.quote: Biscuit used to tremble at the groomer's door. Here, he trots straight in — tail going full speed. The team's patience is unreal.
The de-shedding treatment paid for itself within a week of vacuuming. Worth every penny — and Olive comes home genuinely happy.
Our cat is terrified of strangers, and they handled her like seasoned pros. She came home calm, fluffy and somehow smelling great.

visit.title: Come say hello — we can't wait to meet your pet
visit.lead: Book ahead and your pet walks straight in. Pop-ins are welcome for nail trims on weekdays.

booking.hint: Takes about 60 seconds. No payment needed today.
